message.content:
**Allele frequency of rs7412 (APOE e2) in Europeans**

| Population subset | Minor‑allele frequency (MAF) |
|-------------------|------------------------------|
| Non‑Finnish Europeans (gnomAD v2.1.1) | **≈ 0.04–0.05** (4–5 %) |
| Finnish Europeans (gnomAD v2.1.1) | **≈ 0.06–0.07** (6–7 %) |

So, in the broad “European” category you’ll find a MAF of roughly **5 %** (range 4–7 % depending on sub‑population). This figure comes from the gnomAD database (v2.1.1), which aggregates exome and genome sequencing data from >140 000 individuals of European descent.
